name: WALKFLOW Demo — Home Services: Request Capture, Area Check, Assignment

parameters.content:
PREPARED, NOT TESTED.

Mirrors n8n-workflows/real-estate/01-enquiry-matching-assignment.json's setup exactly:
1. Import into n8n.
2. Create credential 'walkflow-demo-supabase' (Header Auth: apikey + Authorization: Bearer <service_role key>) — never the anon key.
3. Replace YOUR-PROJECT in every HTTP Request node's URL.
4. Require header 'x-walkflow-webhook-secret' matching N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET on the Webhook node's Authentication.
5. Activate, copy the production webhook URL into N8N_HOME_SERVICES_WEBHOOK_URL, then test end to end before enabling Connected Mode.

Corresponds to src/lib/home-services-demo/contract.ts action 'submit_request'. The Function node below must port checkServiceArea()/assignCrew() from src/components/demo/home-services/engine.ts so Connected Mode and Preview Mode never disagree.
